cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Consequences Compound
cards.instruction: Make each new choice carry a larger reward, cost, audience, or point of no return.

mechanism: Copy an allergy label as a competitive name card, then make a snack choice carry progressively larger personal exposure at a meeting.
confusable: Not merely demanding praise for baking: B2 must expose the copied label's actual purpose and A must turn placement advice into a larger audience.
comparison: Food-label misunderstanding and personal attribution rather than sports betting and contract witnesses.
seedUse: Retains biscuits/neighborhood meeting/name-on-plate stake, with distinct copied allergy label.
